paite: Zion aw, halh in, halh in, na hatna silh in; Jerusalem aw, khopi siangthou, na puansilh kilawmtakte silh in; tuban zeksum louh leh minin na sung ah alutta kei ding uh.
heading: Pathian In Jerusalem Ahunkhe Ding
english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

paite: Jerusalem aw, na tung a bang leivui sing in; thou inla, tu in; Zion tanu aw, sal a om, na ngawng gaknate phel in.
english: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: "Bangmah lou a zuak na hi ua; huchi in dangka lou a tat na hita ding uh," chi in.
english: For Yahweh says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ka mite atung in Aigupta gam a om ding in apaisuk ua; Assuria mite'n athu-ala bei in anuaisiah uhi.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.

paite: Tu a, ke'n hiai a bang ahia ka neih?" "Ka mite bangmah lou in pimang in a-om ua," TOUPA'N achi. Atung ua vaihawmte nuam in a-awng ua, TOUPA'N achi, "Ni tumtum in ka min gensiat in a-om hi.
english: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says Yahweh, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

paite: Huaiziak in ka mite'n ka min athei ding uh; huai ni in agenpa ka hi chih athei ding ua; ngai in, keimah ka hi," chi in.
english: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”

paite: Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupih a, thil hoih tanchinhoih tun a, hotdamna thu tangkoupih a, Zion kiang a, "Na Pathian kumpi in atu, chimi khe akilawm hi!
english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

paite: Ngai in! na galvil mite'n aw suah in, nuamsatak in la asa chiat uh; TOUPA Zion a ahong kik nawn chiang a kimaituah a mu ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when Yahweh returns to Zion.

paite: Jerusalem mun sesate aw, nuam sakhe guih unla, nuamsatak in la sa un; TOUPA'N amite alungmuanta a, Jerusalem atanta hi.
english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA'N nam chih mitmuh in aban siangthou alemta; huchi in kawlmong a mi tengteng in i Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh.
english: Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

paite: Pawt un, pawt un, huai a kipan in pawt un, thilnin himhim lawng kei un; asung a kipan paikhia un; TOUPA belsuan tawite aw, siangthoutak in om un.
english: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry Yahweh’s vessels.

paite: Kintak in na paikhe kei ding ua, taikek in na pai sam kei ding uh; TOUPA'N na ma uh pi ding ahi ngal a; Israel' Pathian na nungdal uh ahi ding hi.
english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for Yahweh will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

paite: Ngai in, ka sikha in piltak in ahih ding, pahtawi leh tawisang in a-om ding a, sangpi in a-om ding.
heading: Gimthuak Sikha
english: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.

paite: Mi tampi'n lamdang honsak bang un, amel mihing mel sang in asesak zaw a, apiandan lah mihing tate piandan sang mah ahihsiat in a-om.
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

paite: Huchi in ama'n nam tampi tung ah sisan atheh ding; Kumpipate'n amah lak ah akam uh achih ding uh; akiang ua gen ngei louh amu ding ua; bil a azak ngei louh uh angaisiam ding uhi.
english: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.
